```{r}
# Load libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggrepel)
library(rprojroot)
```

```{r setup-paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-rna-expression")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
```

```{r}
rnaseq_file <- file.path(data_dir, "gene-counts-rsem-expected_count-collapsed.all.rds")
metadata_file <- file.path(data_dir, "miRNA-sample-metadata.txt")
```

```{r}
# Load RNA-seq counts
rnaseq_counts <- readRDS(rnaseq_file) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(everything(), ~ . != 0)) >= 2)
```

```{r}
# Load histology file
histology_df <- read_csv(file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "histology-preprocessing", "results", "histologies.csv")) %>%
  filter(experimental_strategy == "RNA-Seq") %>%
  mutate(batch = if_else(external_sample_id %in% c(
    "2-1578-CC1", "3-1890-CC1", "5-1234-left-pons"),
    "batch1", "batch2")) %>%
  mutate(histology = if_else(is.na(histology), "Normal", histology)) %>%
  filter(Bioassay_ID %in% colnames(rnaseq_counts)) %>%
  arrange(match(Bioassay_ID, colnames(rnaseq_counts))) %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
    sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ paste0(histology, "-adjacent Normal"),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

stopifnot(identical(histology_df$Bioassay_ID, colnames(rnaseq_counts)))

# Round expected counts to nearest integer
rnaseq_mat <- round(rnaseq_counts)

# Create DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rnaseq_mat,
                              colData = histology_df,
                              design = ~ condition)

# VST transformation
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)

# PCA plot
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("condition", "batch"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

pca_data$sample_type <- case_when(
  grepl("adjacent Normal", pca_data$condition) ~ "Normal-Tumor Adjacent",
  pca_data$condition == "Normal"              ~ "Normal",
  TRUE                                        ~ "Tumor"
)

p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = name), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50) +
  labs(title = "PCA of RNA-seq Samples",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_Publication()

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "rna_seq_pca.pdf"), plot = p, width = 10, height = 6)

# View plot
print(p)
```

```{r}
# Count sample types per histology
sample_summary <- histology_df %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal-Tumor Adjacent")) %>%
  count(histology, sample_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(histology)

# View the result
print(sample_summary)

```

# PCA by Tumor Type vs Controls

```{r}
tumor_types <- c("ATRT", "DIPG", "Ependymoma", "HGG", "Medulloblastoma")
controls <- c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5")

for (tumor in tumor_types) {
  tumor_samples <- histology_df %>% filter(histology == tumor & sample_type == "Tumor")
  adjacent_normals <- histology_df %>% filter(sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" & histology == tumor)
  healthy_normals <- histology_df %>% filter(external_sample_id %in% controls)

  subset_metadata <- bind_rows(tumor_samples, adjacent_normals, healthy_normals)
  subset_cts <- rnaseq_mat[, subset_metadata$Bioassay_ID]

  dds_subset <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = subset_cts,
                                       colData = subset_metadata,
                                       design = ~ sample_type)
  vsd_subset <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_subset, blind = FALSE)

  pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd_subset, intgroup = "sample_type", returnData = TRUE)
  percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))
  pca_data$Bioassay_ID <- rownames(pca_data)
  pca_data$external_sample_id <- subset_metadata$external_sample_id

  # Join to get sample_id for labeling
  #pca_data <- left_join(pca_data, subset_metadata, by = "Bioassay_ID")

  # Now use sample_id for label
  p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = sample_type, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = external_sample_id)) +
  labs(title = paste("PCA -", tumor, "vs Controls"),
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_Publication()
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("pca_", tumor, "_vs_controls.pdf")), plot = p, width = 10, height = 6)
}
```
